Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: d4builds A 'Hammerdin' (guide 'Blessed Hammer - Paladin (S15)', last updated 2026-09-15) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds: absent from its Season 15 list [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll B endgame, C push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: the highest-weighted site A vs Maxroll B/C - the largest Paladin split. Construction: late endgame = d4builds 'Mythic (P230)' (weighted first) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/blessed-hammer-paladin-endgame/ - 2026-09-16]; leveling 'Leveling 1-70', early endgame 'Midgame' and push 'Push' = Maxroll planner gy27fc0t (guide author aoinomiku, updated 2026-09-15) [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/gy27fc0t - 2026-09-16]. Differences d4builds vs Maxroll Endgame: bar (d4builds Aegis + Condemn; Maxroll Falling Star + Holy Light Aura); chest runes (Cir+Vex vs Cem+Lac); pants (d4builds legendary Bulwark's Aspect with Igni+Lac vs Maxroll Temerity with Igni+Gar); shield (Aspect of Utmost Glory legendary vs Herald of Zakarum); ring slots swapped; amulet splinter Sin on both; talisman (d4builds Diamond Mind 4+2 vs Maxroll Legendary seal + 5-piece Light's Epiphany + Griswold's Opus - d4builds lists that as its 'No Mythic Seal' option); glyph board order. d4builds' embedded second variant is a Season 14 'Starter (P200)/Uber (P230)' build (2026-04-26) and is not used. 3.2.1: Disciple Oath 100%; Judgement rank scaling (not central); core stat 1.625 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Maintain Arbiter of Justice through Condemn (Disciple); Aegis, Fanaticism Aura and Defiance Aura on cooldown; then spam Evade and Blessed Hammer - in Arbiter form Evade auto-casts Blessed Hammer via Argent Veil.
Variants

Leveling — Hold Blessed Hammer; Fanaticism Aura on cooldown for Vulnerable with Exploit; Defiance Aura when stunned; Advance and Falling Star to move. [Maxroll gy27fc0t, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to Midgame when Herald's Morningstar and Argent Veil drop (upgrade common maces/rings in the Cube) and you have boots with 'Attacks Reduce Evade's Cooldown'.

Early Endgame — Hold Blessed Hammer; in Arbiter form press Evade to auto-cast Blessed Hammer via Argent Veil ('bind Evade to the scroll wheel'); Fanaticism Aura on cooldown; Defiance Aura when stunned; Falling Star for gaps. [Maxroll gy27fc0t, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to the d4builds kit when Fists of Fate and Ring of Starless Skies are Mythic and you own Seal of the Diamond Mind.

Late Endgame — Maintain Arbiter of Justice via Condemn thanks to Disciple; cast Aegis, Fanaticism Aura and Defiance Aura on cooldown; spam Evade and Blessed Hammer. [d4builds notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to Maxroll's Push kit when Temerity and Herald of Zakarum are Mythic - it trades Falling Star's speed for Consecration's damage and healing.

Pushing — Hold Blessed Hammer and spam Evade in Arbiter form; Consecration for healing and damage; Fanaticism Aura on cooldown; Defiance Aura when stunned; Holy Light Aura for extra healing. [Maxroll gy27fc0t push notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage.

How to run them

d4builds S15: Raheir hired, Aldkin's Field of Languish on Blessed Hammer. Maxroll: Raheir 'great defensively while providing a decent damage multiplier thanks to Inspiration'; Aldkin's Field of Languish 'gives us an extra damage reduction every so often'.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: d4builds A 'Hammerdin' (guide 'Blessed Hammer - Paladin (S15)', last updated 2026-09-15) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds: absent from its Season 15 list [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll B endgame, C push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: the highest-weighted site A vs Maxroll B/C - the largest Paladin split. Construction: late endgame = d4builds 'Mythic (P230)' (weighted first) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/blessed-hammer-paladin-endgame/ - 2026-09-16]; leveling 'Leveling 1-70', early endgame 'Midgame' and push 'Push' = Maxroll planner gy27fc0t (guide author aoinomiku, updated 2026-09-15) [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/gy27fc0t - 2026-09-16]. Differences d4builds vs Maxroll Endgame: bar (d4builds Aegis + Condemn; Maxroll Falling Star + Holy Light Aura); chest runes (Cir+Vex vs Cem+Lac); pants (d4builds legendary Bulwark's Aspect with Igni+Lac vs Maxroll Temerity with Igni+Gar); shield (Aspect of Utmost Glory legendary vs Herald of Zakarum); ring slots swapped; amulet splinter Sin on both; talisman (d4builds Diamond Mind 4+2 vs Maxroll Legendary seal + 5-piece Light's Epiphany + Griswold's Opus - d4builds lists that as its 'No Mythic Seal' option); glyph board order. d4builds' embedded second variant is a Season 14 'Starter (P200)/Uber (P230)' build (2026-04-26) and is not used. 3.2.1: Disciple Oath 100%; Judgement rank scaling (not central); core stat 1.625 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Maintain Arbiter of Justice through Condemn (Disciple); Aegis, Fanaticism Aura and Defiance Aura on cooldown; then spam Evade and Blessed Hammer - in Arbiter form Evade auto-casts Blessed Hammer via Argent Veil.
Variants

Leveling — Hold Blessed Hammer; Fanaticism Aura on cooldown for Vulnerable with Exploit; Defiance Aura when stunned; Advance and Falling Star to move. [Maxroll gy27fc0t, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to Midgame when Herald's Morningstar and Argent Veil drop (upgrade common maces/rings in the Cube) and you have boots with 'Attacks Reduce Evade's Cooldown'.

Early Endgame — Hold Blessed Hammer; in Arbiter form press Evade to auto-cast Blessed Hammer via Argent Veil ('bind Evade to the scroll wheel'); Fanaticism Aura on cooldown; Defiance Aura when stunned; Falling Star for gaps. [Maxroll gy27fc0t, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to the d4builds kit when Fists of Fate and Ring of Starless Skies are Mythic and you own Seal of the Diamond Mind.

Late Endgame — Maintain Arbiter of Justice via Condemn thanks to Disciple; cast Aegis, Fanaticism Aura and Defiance Aura on cooldown; spam Evade and Blessed Hammer. [d4builds notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to Maxroll's Push kit when Temerity and Herald of Zakarum are Mythic - it trades Falling Star's speed for Consecration's damage and healing.

Pushing — Hold Blessed Hammer and spam Evade in Arbiter form; Consecration for healing and damage; Fanaticism Aura on cooldown; Defiance Aura when stunned; Holy Light Aura for extra healing. [Maxroll gy27fc0t push notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage.

Reasoning

Based onShield Charge Thorns Paladin
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Damage skill Shield Charge (Physical Thorns) -> Blessed Hammer (Holy): d4builds rates Hammerdin A alongside Thorns - the only other Paladin build it rates A.
  2. Oath Juggernaut -> Disciple: Condemn keeps Arbiter of Justice up 'thanks to Disciple' (d4builds); 3.2.1 raised Disciple Oath 80% -> 100%.
  3. Bar: Clash, Shield Charge, Fortress out; Blessed Hammer, Aegis, Arbiter of Justice in (d4builds: Blessed Hammer, Fanaticism Aura, Defiance Aura, Aegis, Condemn, Arbiter of Justice).
  4. Mobility loop: Argent Veil ring + Aspect of the Arbiter's Zephyr boots + 'Attacks Reduce Evade's Cooldown' boots affix - spam Evade, which auto-casts Blessed Hammer in Arbiter form.
  5. Uniques: Mantle of the Grey / Tibault's Will / Penitent Greaves / Blood-Mad Idol -> Squirt's Blouse, Herald's Morningstar, Fists of Fate, Argent Veil, Ring of Starless Skies; Leoric's Crown stays, and the shield is a legendary with Aspect of Utmost Glory on d4builds (Herald of Zakarum on Maxroll).
  6. Talisman: Righteous Will 4-piece -> Light's Epiphany 4-piece (+ Iron Conviction 2-piece stays) on Seal of the Diamond Mind.
  7. Paragon glyphs: Revenge/Outmatch/Spirit/Sentinel/Honed -> Spirit/Honed/Arbiter/Canny/Apostle on the same five boards.
  8. Mercenary: Subo + Aldkin -> Raheir + Aldkin (Field of Languish on Blessed Hammer) per d4builds.

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 secondseconds.

Raheir's Guard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

Vanguard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir Slows surrounding enemies by 40%.

Mocking Lure

PassiveRaheir

You deal 15%[x] increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.

Iron Wolf's Ward

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Iron Wolf's Call

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal 25%[x] increased damage and cost no Resource.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's final Crater burst deals 200%[x] increased damage and inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 secondseconds.

Iron Wolf's Virtue

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Inspiration

PassiveRaheir

Enemies affected by Raheir's Ground Slam take 15%[x] increased damage.

Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal 25%[x] increased damage.

Raheir's Aegis

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15% Resistance to All Elements.

Draw Fire

PassiveRaheir

When you use a Healing Potion, Raheir Taunts enemies around him for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 20 seconds.
